prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on this, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision at the intersection in League City, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving. I had a green light heading east through the intersection.

Q: Tell me what happened as you remember it.

A: I was about to cross when a pickup coming from the north ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact spun me partway around. I hit my head on the window frame pretty hard.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or feel dazed afterward?

A: I don't think I passed out, but I was foggy for a while. Everything felt slow and I had trouble remembering what I'd been doing right before.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that evening. They did a CT scan and told me I have a concussion. They said to limit screens and reading and to rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. I get headaches most afternoons, and bright lights bother me. I've been sleeping more than usual and I get tired quickly.

Q: Did you have any prior head injuries or concussions?

A: No, nothing I can recall.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been out of work since the accident, and I'm still waiting to hear back from my doctor about follow-up appointments.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Okay, thanks.
